referenceImages.name: Tytuvėnai Monastery Servants’ House
referenceImages.scope: The standing exterior of Tytuvėnai Monastery Servants’ House. One-storey servants’ house with plastered brick walls, a gabled tile roof, molded chimney and rectangular openings.
referenceImages.era: Standing exterior reconstructed from the surveyed pre-modern building and current mapped outline.

review.notes: Reviewed Qualla’s published originals first. The cleared exteriors depict the main church, chapel and gallery. None identifies this outbuilding clearly. The model uses the written heritage survey and mapped geometry.
